build_toprow.py — the U5 arm's curated dir: the 29 S_top-over-bar members lose their
TOP 800 rows (Siril y-down 0..800 = FITS rows H-800..H) as Siril `crop` of a COPY of the
member AS THE CHAIN'S CURATED DIR HAS IT; every other member symlinked to the same target
the chain's dir resolves to. Then every copy is verified the way the stage verifies
(row-adapted) and the curated record is written. Measurement arm scratch — nothing here
touches the chain's curated dir, the canonical, a member or a raw.

    python3 sessions/aug14/work/toprow/build_toprow.py
crop_convention: Siril `crop 0 800 W H-800` — Siril counts y DOWN from the top, so this removes the display's top 800 rows = FITS rows H-800..H (astropy y up); the copy keeps FITS rows 0..H-800 and its CRPIX2 is unchanged (the FITS origin row survives) — VERIFIED per copy by pixel identity against that slab
